multiplayer.note: Transport-agnostic authoritative server with explicit development/raw-UDP and production/QUIC-TLS profiles, 60 Hz authority, 20 Hz acknowledged deltas/keyframes, prediction, ownership, and combat. Protocol 7 rejects mismatched content; optional HMAC supplies client authentication on either profile. One authoritative registry owns session tokens and timeout cleanup; secure-random failures fail closed and keyed disconnects require credentials. GameState includes restart round and authoritative mover tick positions; sequenced commands from old rounds are discarded. Bounded partial-world replication retains one acknowledged baseline and one retryable packet per peer, respects active payload limits, rotates fair/priority records and peers, and exposes queue/delivery counters. Supports 1024 relevant records with individually budgeted records; protocol 7 binds replication/resync to sessions. See HOSTING.md for limits and RTT tradeoffs.

contract.owns: Authoritative sessions and bounded acknowledged replication
contract.inputs: Bounded client intentions and transport outcomes
contract.performance: One baseline and one retryable packet per peer; active transport payload ceiling

constraints.text: Commit only exactly acknowledged represented state; budget each packet against the active transport limit. Queued bytes are not delivery.

decisions.rejected: Raising the packet ceiling or retaining full-world history
decisions.reason: Bounded partial-world acknowledgements preserve progress under loss and pressure
decisions.reconsider_when: Transport and measured latency requirements change

performance_regression_budgets.note: Canonical headless measurements are checked against shared absolute service ceilings; tests and the CLI fail nonzero on regression. Thresholds include heterogeneous CI headroom and are not hardware-normalized baselines.

landscaping.note: Reusable static broadleaf, pine, clustered shrub and flower builders. Preserve collision routes; no alpha textures or animation.

asset_library.note: Unified JSON catalog API over native and data-only prefabs; qualified stable IDs, metadata search, external game-local packs and review-gated promotion proposals. Reuse, modify, generate, then import.

interior_prefabs.note: Data-only prefab scenes and quarter-turn placement; preserves source and validates with packaged native audit.

Games own presentation, hit-shape policy and their transport shell.

arena_shooter_foundation.note: Opt-in, rendering-independent arena FPS layer: validated accelerated ground/air movement, configurable grounded step-up, friction, held-jump momentum chaining, 90-degree camera policy, launch volumes, timed pickups, deterministic projectiles and splash falloff, armor, free-for-all frags and fixed-tick respawns. Existing default movement remains unchanged.

prototype_api.note: SceneBuilder requires an explicit spawn and batches ordinary map edits; box_body includes a semantic ID while structural_box creates visual collision without a reachability target. World impulse/prop_position use IDs, not borrowed body indices. HeadlessWorld supports transactional map/game replacement with player respawn; network hosts must coordinate content changes. No generic scripting or arbitrary dynamic mesh builder.

Eligibility and presentation visibility are independent replicated states; hidden entities retain collision. Native game-describe/schema/validate/example; --game on client and headless. No scripting or physical doors.

shared_gameplay.note: Standard new-game and stock --game consume playable::run_game_with_options: local HeadlessWorld authority without sockets, or server-owned state with shared prediction/interpolation. Authored objectives, timers, movers, dynamic props and win/restart run through the same simulation. Protocol 7 replicates round identity and mover positions. Graphics-free GameSession supports scripted clients and tests. MapPlayer/run_map is a static viewer only. Any joined player can restart after completion; existing packet-size limits remain.
